She wears a white ribbed turtleneck sweater and a white plush headband. Behind her, multiple luxury handbags including Chanel and Hermes are displayed on backlit glass shelves. (3) A close-up shot features a gold-packaged eye sheet mask from 'Derma Laser'. The main character's hands hold the packaging while variety-style text overlays appear at the top describing the product. (4) The character applies white crescent-shaped eye patches under her eyes. She smiles and gestures with her hands towards her face, while the lighting remains bright and warm. (5) A screen-style insert appears showing an 'LDK the Beauty' award for the product. The character continues to talk, holding the packaging near her face. (6) The character is seen applying a full golden-colored face mask. The main character then applies the red lipstick to her lips, tilting her head slightly. (8) The scene shifts to her holding multiple skincare products together, smiling warmly at the camera. The background remains the luxury closet setting with soft, high-key lighting.
